name: A Program to Provide 90 Percent Assistance in Planting Material of Horticultural Fruit Crops
benefit:
- Farmers receive up to 90% financial assistance on the cost of planting materials. > **Pre-fixed assistance rates per hectare for different crops:**
Fruit Assistance Mango₹32,000/haSapota (Chiku)₹22,000/haPomegranate₹20,000/haGuava₹16,650/haAonla (Indian Gooseberry)₹5,560/haMandarin / Orange₹5,560/haBer₹2,780/haCoconut₹13,000/ha
> **Note:** - Only saplings costing up to ₹250/- per un
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must purchase planting materials from approved/accredited sources.
